title: APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION AS A PERFORMANCE INSPECTION AGENT
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Form 12] <Amended 2021.9.7>

APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION AS A PERFORMANCE INSPECTION AGENT

(Front)

| Receipt number | Date of receipt | Processing period |
|---|---|---|
| ____________________ | ____________________ | 30 days |

| Section | Field | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Applicant | Name of corporation or institution | ____________________ |
| | Representative's name | ____________________ |
| | Date of birth | ____________________ |
| | Address | ____________________ (Telephone number: ____________________) |

I hereby apply for registration as a performance inspection agent pursuant to Article 27(1) of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act, Article 14(1) of the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and Article 14(1) of the Enforcement Rule of that Act.

Year _____ Month _____ Day _____

Applicant ____________________ (Signature or seal)

To: Mayor/Do Governor

ATTACHMENTS

Documents to be submitted by the applicant:
1. A specification of the facilities and equipment for performance inspections.
2. Particulars of the inspection technical personnel employed and their construction technology career certificates (only where recognition of practical experience is necessary).

Matters to be verified by the public official in charge:
1. Certification of business registration or a certificate of registered corporate particulars (only in the case of a corporation).
2. Confirmation of the acquisition of national technical qualifications by the technical personnel employed.

Fee: 20,000 won

CONSENT TO THE JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION

I consent to the public official in charge verifying the matters listed above for official verification, in connection with the processing of this matter, through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 of the Electronic Government Act.
* If consent is withheld, the applicant shall submit the relevant documents directly.

Applicant ____________________ (Signature or seal)

210 mm × 297 mm [white woodfree paper, 80 g/m²]

(Back)

PROCESSING PROCEDURE

This application is processed as follows.

| Applicant | Processing authority (Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Do, or Special Self-Governing Province) |
|---|---|
| Application → | Receive application |
| | ↓ Review documents and conduct an on-site investigation |
| | ↓ Approval |
| | ↓ Prepare registration certificate |
| Registration certificate issued to applicant ← | Enter in register |
